description: This file defines a class 'SyncOpStatus' that manages and monitors the status of synchronization operations, including tracking progress, timing, errors, and emitting events related to sync state changes.

classes.name: SyncOpStatus
classes.description: Class responsible for managing synchronization operation statuses, including progress tracking, error handling, and timing monitoring.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the timing monitor and cleans up resources.

methods.name: setUploadStatus
methods.description: Updates the upload progress and emits a status change event.

methods.name: setDownloadStatus
methods.description: Updates the download progress and emits a status change event.

methods.name: setDatabaseLoadStatus
methods.description: Sets the database load status and emits corresponding events based on completion.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Returns current statistics of sync progress, including upload, download, and database load metrics.

methods.name: setDidBegin
methods.description: Marks the start of a sync operation and records the start time.

methods.name: setDidEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of a sync operation.

methods.name: syncInProgress
methods.description: Getter indicating whether a sync is currently in progress.

methods.name: secondsSinceSyncStart
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration in seconds since the sync started.

methods.name: startTimingMonitor
methods.description: Starts a monitor that checks if the sync is taking too long and notifies via the receiver.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Returns whether there has been an error during sync.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the sync status and state variables to initial values.
